//: The brick kiln's firebox. The same arrangement as the mud one with the shell course laid in fire clay brick instead of mud brick - the two parts the flame actually touches, this and the wicket, are fire clay either way; the 5x5 drum around them will take any fired brick.

The wicket, two panels to a craft because the entrance is one block wide and two tall. Vanilla's own kiln door recipe with the metal list moved down a tier: the strapping and the pintles are on the outer face, where a thick brick panel keeps them a long way under the copper's melting point, so there is no reason this needs iron. Bronze is accepted on the same argument - tin bronze melts cooler than copper does, and neither is anywhere near the fire.
name: Kiln wicket panel
